methodology.in_flight: none — Stack A closed as a powered null (hyp-000161); one more powered null closes the format
rules: Two layers max until the format has produced one result; three after (Stack A produced one on Sept 13th).
First test is paired: trigger alone vs trigger inside the context. The claim is the difference.
Both formats run; at most one stack in flight at a time.
Floor 100 occurrences + minimum detectable effect pre-registered by Statistical. Below the floor → UNDERPOWERED: an attempt spent, definition never loosened.
One mechanism per layer plus an explicit interaction claim. 'It filters out losers' is rejected as fitting.
Every layer known before the trigger fires, context before location (the timing rule, per layer).
Full spec hashed into the trial registry before any look; a different hash is a different trial. Cells looked at are recorded with it.
A stacks_attempted counter makes the format accountable.
A stack of already-closed variables is a resurrection unless the interaction is the stated novel claim.
Format kill: two powered nulls close the format. One so far.
methodology.summary: Two admissible hypothesis shapes: FLAT (one state, one window) and CONDITIONAL STACK (context -> location -> trigger), both under the same promotion bar, splits and trial accounting. Adopted Sept 13th ~9:00 pm CT, disposition MODIFY, ten binding rules.
